featuredArticle.excerpt: 30 Harvestide, 1040 BF. The Scorncrow put the paladin down with crows; Archie slammed it out of the air onto Remi; and Remi, pinned at point-blank range, fired a musket into its face and found human blood. The party followed it into the tree's mouth, Archie sealed the only exit burning it, and five descended by rope into the Skittering Grove — webs for foliage, wrapped bodies for fruit, and Legion soldiers inside.

didYouKnow: ...that the Scorncrow told three separate filings it was not a monster, and when Remi Akamatsu finally tested the claim with a point-blank musket, the blood under the face was human?
...that Remi escaped two armed dungeon guards by drawing a goblin face on a cardboard box with a Sharpie marker and claiming to be a certified Box Guardian?
...that the Mount Ebott Survey Part VII file features Sans executing Flowey in a localized time-stop after recalling a midnight tea conversation with King Asgore?

editorialDirective.title: WAH! Editorial Directive — The Correction:
editorialDirective.text: Three filings called it a monster on its own denial. One shot at zero inches says otherwise. Stop using the word until somebody recovers the face. WAH!
